title: 専門ゼミ(機械工学科)
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III (Mechanical Engineering)
keywords: Mechanical engineering 2.Engineering design 3.Problem finding 4.Career design 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Propose Design Project III issues in the field of mechanical engineering. (2) Learn how to use technical knowledge and skill for solving those issues. (3) Learn how to develop a comprehensive ability as an engineer. (4) Learn the importance of collaboration with regional society (especially the local community).
advice: Issues to be addressed in Design Project III are presented. Students will understand the knowledge and skills required to carry out the project and learn what knowledge needs to be supplemented. During the course of this seminar, students will clarify their project purpose and action plan, and finally make a proposal. Note: Details will be explained during the first class.
books: It wiil be given as needed.
requiredKnowledge: If you cannot successfully complete this course, you cannot take Design Project III

activityGoals.body: Be able to clarify the purpose and action plan for your design project.
Be able to explain the issues of the design project and make a schedule.
Be able to collect articles in specialized fields on the design project and use them in the project.
Be able to understand the safety management guidelines for conducting experiments and research safely.
Be able to see your future course and choose the direction you should follow.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Clearly present the goals, action plans, and originality of your project in writing and orally. (2) Understand the issues in your project logically and create a project schedule. (3) Collect articles on special fields related to your project and use them. (4) Understand safety management guidelines for conducting experiments and research safely, and use them to design and improve safe experimental procedures. (5) Clarify your career plan and the knowledge you need to learn to achieve it.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Clearly describe the goals, action plans, and originality of your project. (2) Understand the issues in your project logically. (3) Collect articles on special fields related to your project. (4) Understand safety management guidelines for conducting experiments and research safely. (5) Imagine your future career.
